statusDefinitions.supported: Available in the documented public profile without a material Nidomo-specific limitation for the named concept.
statusDefinitions.supported_with_limits: Available, but Nidomo intentionally supports a bounded subset or documented divergence.
statusDefinitions.experimental: Implemented or under active integration; public shape/availability may change before certification.
statusDefinitions.unsupported: Not available in the current profile; future support is not committed.
statusDefinitions.intentionally_unsupported: Deliberately excluded from the Nidomo public model/security boundary.
statusDefinitions.nidomo_extension: Nidomo-native capability with no standards-equivalence claim.
statusDefinitions.planned: Intended direction without a current implementation claim.

html-policy-v2.label: HTML document policy v2
html-policy-v2.description: Authoritative bounded HTML policy that defines accepted document structure, elements, attributes, and Nidomo form bindings.

html-syntax-selftest.label: HTML syntax self-test
html-syntax-selftest.description: Executable parser conformance coverage for document construction, void elements, attributes, character references, optional closures, and explicit syntax rejection.

web-standards-selftest.label: Web standards self-test
web-standards-selftest.description: Executable integration coverage across the current HTML/CSS profile, including Nidomo form bindings, CSS cascade behavior, scoped URLs, media queries, and explicit unsupported behavior.

css-profile-3.label: CSS profile 3
css-profile-3.description: Authoritative bounded CSS parser/cascade contract for supported properties, selectors, units, pseudo-classes, media constraints, and explicit exclusions.

creator-standards-cutover.label: Creator Standards Cutover
creator-standards-cutover.description: Active production-integration gate for standards-first creator authoring; experimental language claims remain bounded by this gate until certification.

creator-language-hard-cut.label: Creator Language Hard-Cut
creator-language-hard-cut.description: Locked migration gate that rejects legacy creator-language formats for new authoring while preserving migration/history boundaries.

javascript-compiler-selftest.label: JavaScript/TypeScript compiler self-test
javascript-compiler-selftest.description: Executable compiler/runtime coverage for TypeScript and JavaScript through the IR2 runtime, including JS semantics and rejection of the legacy source extension.

creator-build-selftest.label: Creator multi-language build self-test
creator-build-selftest.description: Executable creator workflow coverage for TypeScript, JavaScript, and Luau project initialization/build behavior plus TypeScript publish/install/run lifecycle.

dlp8-web-facade-selftest.label: DLP8 web facade self-test
dlp8-web-facade-selftest.description: Executable coverage for the bounded page-facing document, element, events, storage, request, and navigation facades.

dlp7-application-facade-selftest.label: DLP7 application facade self-test
dlp7-application-facade-selftest.description: Executable coverage for the Nidomo application modules, capability checks, quotas, owned handles, and isolation boundaries.

nidomo-web-platform-contract.label: Nidomo web platform contract
nidomo-web-platform-contract.description: Architecture boundary for hosted web capabilities, including mediated networking and the absence of unrestricted browser embedding semantics.

nidomo-url-contract.label: Nidomo URL contract
nidomo-url-contract.description: Architecture/implementation contract for Nidomo-native URI parsing and routing.
